audit_item: Dust filter on electrical box should be removed and cleaned out with compressed air. Keep nozzle 6 inches away from filter to avoid damaging it, replace filter if necessary.

1) Inspect conveyor chain every 500 hours of operation.
2) Raise the hold down assembly, (using screwdrivers) lift conveyor chain up out of its slide trough.
3) Should be enough slack to lift high enough to see condition of the plastic tape using a light. It is normal for grooves to be worn in tape. The tape is (1/32) inch thick and must be replaced BEFORE is wears through. 
4) If tape must be replaced, refer to section on CHANGING THE UHMW TAPE ON 390 SHAPER (page 23 of manual).
